# The fitness trainer that feels real.

Looking for a Supernatural or FitXR alternative?

Meet **Train Together**. 

A fitness experience built around something most workout apps are missing: genuine human connection.

Train with lifelike AI trainers that adapt to you, remember your preferences, and respond naturally during your workouts. Choose a trainer that motivates you the way you want to be motivated.

[media]

Supportive or demanding. Calm or energetic. Encouraging or brutally honest.

Whether your goal is strength, cardio, boxing, recovery, posture, mobility, focus, or simply feeling better, every session feels personal, engaging, and surprisingly natural.

Bring your trainer into your own room with Mixed Reality, or step into beautiful virtual worlds designed to keep exercise fresh and motivating.

Train Together includes:

- Your very own personal trainer
- 2000+ trainer customization and personality options.
- 100+ workouts, all featuring original music tracks
- Tons of features and new modes to try!
- Themed content packs including Combat, K-Pop, Wellness, Farm Fit, Tropical Beach, Rock Gods, Superheroes, and more!


[media]

When motivation disappears, variety matters.

With new content, new trainers, new personalities, and new experiences regularly added, there's always a reason to come back.

You don't need perfect discipline.

You need a trainer you'll actually want to spend time with.

[media]

**Train Together: Try it free today.**


For support, community, roadmap and more: please visit www.verseus-games.com
